name: Edwards AFB
description: Home of 412th Test Wing — premier Air Force flight test center.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass at the Visitor Control Center at West Gate.

resources.name: Edwards AFB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency grocery with bakery, deli, and CLICK2GO curbside pickup.

resources.name: 412th Medical Group
resources.description: Ambulatory MTF — primary care, specialty clinics, pharmacy, dental, and behavioral health. 24/7 paramedic ambulance service. No emergency department on base.

resources.name: 412th Medical Group Pharmacy

resources.name: 412th Dental Squadron
resources.description: General dentistry for active-duty and eligible beneficiaries.
resources.address: 30 Nightingale Rd, Bldg 5525, Edwards AFB, CA 93524

resources.name: Rosburg Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness center with weight room, cardio equipment, basketball, racquetball, and group exercise. 24/7 CAC access after registration.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0500-2100, Sat-Sun 0800-1800; 24/7 CAC access after registration
resources.address: 210 W Popson Ave, Bldg 2200, Edwards AFB, CA 93524

resources.name: Armed Forces Bank
resources.description: Full-service military bank branch with checking, savings, loans, and ATM services.

resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, separations, and retirements. Appointment-based via RAPIDS.

resources.name: 412th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs — dining, fitness, recreation, lodging, and community events.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, deployment support, financial readiness, newcomers briefing, and family programs.

resources.name: Housing Management Office
resources.description: On-base privatized housing and off-base housing referrals. Required visit before signing any lease.

resources.name: High Desert Inn (AF Lodging)

resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rentals, camping gear, ski lift tickets, theme park tickets, and adventure trips.

resources.name: High Desert Lanes Bowling Center

events.title: The Suriel’s Circle: A Court of Thorns and Recaps
events.description: Spill the tea like the suriel! Join fellow fans at Edwards Library as we do a deep dive recap of the A Court of Thorns and Roses series to make sure everyone is caught up and ready for the next book release! It’s the perfect place to obsess over the inner circle, revisit the most epic battles and prepare for what’s coming up next in the series! Tuesday, September 29 | 5 – 7 pm Ages 18+ Call 275-BOOK for more information.

events.title: Private Pilot Ground School Course
events.description: Sign up for Aero Club’s Private Pilot Ground School! This 10-week course with live instructors is based on the ASA Pilot’s Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge. September 30 | 5:30 – 8:30 pm $275 with certificate of completion or $35 for individual classes Location: Don Thomson Conference Room, Bldg. 1202, 235 S. Flightline Rd Pre-registration is required Call (661) 275-2376 to register or for more information!

events.title: Pin Decorating Contest
events.description: Get ready for some scary creativity! High Desert Lanes is back with our Annual Pin Decorating Contest! Turn a regular bowling pin into a masterpiece this Halloween. Will yours be a spooky mummy, a werewolf, or something even more terrifying? Pick up your pin starting OCT 1 at the Bowling Center. Decorate it and return it by OCT 23 for a chance to win the grand prize! Voting runs from OCT 24–28, with the winner announced on Halloween! Don’t wait—pins are only available while supplies last. Let’s see those spooky ideas! Call 275-BOWL for more information

primaryAction.address: Rosamond Blvd, Bldg 1004, Edwards AFB, CA 93524

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Attend the newcomers briefing at the M&FRC.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. High Desert Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season. Dorm management handles unaccompanied housing.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: West Gate (Main), North Gate, and South Gate are open 24/7. Visitor Control Center at West Gate, Bldg 1004, is Mon-Fri 0700-1600. REAL ID required for all visitors.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
